name: The Ritz-Carlton, St. Thomas
insider_take: Perched dramatically on a 150-foot bluff overlooking the pristine waters of Great Bay, this Caribbean jewel offers unparalleled luxury where every suite boasts breathtaking ocean views.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton St. Thomas sits on the former estate of a 19th-century sugar plantation and features the island's only overwater bungalows. The resort's exclusive Red Hook location provides direct access to some of the Caribbean's best sailing waters, while the property's cliff-top infinity pool creates the illusion of swimming directly into the Atlantic horizon.
pro_tip: Book the Sunset Ritual experience at the resort's clifftop ceremony site - it's positioned perfectly to watch the sun disappear behind neighboring islands while sipping champagne 150 feet above the sea.
dont_miss: The nearby Coral World Ocean Park and the famous Magens Bay Beach (consistently rated among the world's most beautiful beaches). Take advantage of the resort's complimentary ferry service to St. John's Virgin Islands National Park, where two-thirds of the island remains pristine tropical forest and untouched beaches.
pros: Spectacular oceanfront location with panoramic Caribbean views
Multiple dining venues with exceptional culinary experiences
Luxury beachfront resort with pristine white sand beach access
cons: Premium pricing for luxury resort experience
Island location requires flight connections for most travelers
